senses.gloss: ताल- + केतु ताल- + केतु, m. (having as banner the palmyra tree), epithet of Bhīṣma, MBh. 5, 5081.

ताल- + जङ्घ ताल- + जङ्घ, 1. adj. long-legged, Rām. 5, 12, 35.
 2. m. The name of a people, Rām. 1, 70, 28.
† तल् तल्, i. 1 and 10. To fulfil a vow.

तल तल, m. and n.
 1. Surface, [] MBh. 3, 2412.
 2. Bottom, Rām. 5, 13, 11.
 3. Without a special signification, as latter part of many comp. words, e. g. नभस्-तल = नभस्, Heaven, Bhāg. P. 2, 1, 27.
 4. The palm, Arj. 3, 40; often compounded with a word denoting hand, e. g. पाणि-तल, MBh. 13, 5013.
 5. Sole of the foot, Rām. 5, 13, 47; usually compounded with a word signifying foot, e. g. पाद-तल, MBh. 13, 7444.
 6. That which is under or below anything, under, Hit. 43, 21; Mṛcch. 34, 11; Man. 2, 59 (अङ्गुष्ठमूलस्य तले, Under the root of the thumb).
 7. (also f. ला), A leathern fence worn by archers on the left arm, MBh. 6, 621 (तलबद्ध = बद्धतल, Having put on a leathern fence, etc., cf. तलत्र), Rām. 2, 87, 23.
 --Comp.

ताल ताल,
 I. m.
 1. The palmyra tree, or fan palm, Borassus flabelliformis, Rām. 1, 1, 64; used as banner, MBh. 6, 1811.
 2. Slapping or clapping the hands together, Megh. 77; often compounded with a word denoting hand, MBh. 13, 1397.
 3. Slapping together in general, Ragh. 9, 71.
 4. Musical measure, Pañc. v. d. 43; MBh. 13, 995.
 5. A sort of cymbal, Pañc. 20, 8.
 II. n. The fruit of the palmyra tree, Hariv. 3711.
 III. f. लि, The name of a tree. Corypha taliera Roxb., Rām. 4, 43, 6.
 --Comp.
तलातल तलातल, i. e. तल-अ-तल, n. the name of a hell, Vedāntas. in Chr. 209, 2.
तल- + ताल तल- + ताल, m. slapping the hands together, MBh. 3, 12379.
तलतस् तल + तस्, adv. From the bottom, Śiś. 9, 20.

तलत्र तल + त्र (vb. त्रा), n. A leathern fence worn by archers on the left arm, MBh. 6, 1673.
 --Comp.

तलिन् तलिन्, i. e. तल + इन्, adj., f. नी, [] Wearing the leathern fence of the archers (see तल,
 7), MBh. 5, 5367.
तालिन् तालिन्, i. e. ताल + इन्, adj. Provided with cymbals, MBh. 13, 1172.

तल्प तल्प, m. and n.
 1. A bed, Man. 3, 3.
 2. A turret, MBh. 1, 7577.
 --Comp.
तल्पक तल्प + क, m. One who makes beds, Kām. Nītis. 12, 45.
तल्पज तल्प-ज, adj. Brought forth in the marriage-bed, Man. 9, 167.
तालावचरण तालावचरण, i. e. तील-अव-चर् + अन, m. A dancer, Rājat. 3, 335.

तालिक तालिक, i. e. ताल + इक,
 I. m. Slapping the hands together, Pañc. ii. d. 137.
 II. f. का, The palm, Hariv. 9920.
तालीयक तालीयक, i. e. ताल + ईय + क, A cymbal, Rām. 5, 13, 54.
तालु तालु, n. and m. and तालूषक तालूषक, The palate, Ṛt. 1, 11; MBh. 14, 568; Yājñ. 3, 87.
तल- + त्राण तल- + त्राण, n. a leathern fence worn by archers on the left arm, MBh. 3, 1501.
ताल- + ध्वज ताल- + ध्वज, m. 1. a name of Balarāma, MBh. 9, 2139. 2. the name of a mountain, Śatr. 1, 50.
तल- + प्रहार तल- + प्रहार, m. a stroke with the palm of the hand or claw, Pañc. 215, 21.
ताल-मात्र + म् ताल-मात्र + म्, adv. only a moment, Rām. 3, 50, 19.
ताल- + यन्त्र ताल- + यन्त्र, n. 1. a small pair of pincers, Suśr. 1, 23, 16. 2. a lock.
तल- + लोक तल- + लोक, m. the lower regions, ib. 2, 6, 42.
तालु- + विशोषण तालु- + विशोषण, n. the growing dry of the palate (by much speaking), MBh. 8, 4760.
ताल- + वृन्त ताल- + वृन्त, n. a fan (properly a leaf of the palm-tree), Rām. 5, 20, 14.
ताल- + शब्द ताल- + शब्द, m. 1. noise produced by falling cocoanuts, Hariv. 3715. 2. noise produced by clapping the hands, applause, ib. 4111.
तालु- + शोष तालु- + शोष, m. morbid dryness of the palate, Suśr. 1, 306, 3.
